# Preserve My Estate (MSA Financial)

> Fiduciary wealth, estate, and tax planning for Massachusetts families.
> Preserve My Estate is the educational site of Marino, Stram & Associates, LLC d/b/a MSA
> Financial — an SEC-registered investment adviser (CRD #107768, est. 1997, ~$1.4B AUM as of
> Dec. 31, 2025). Led by Michael Cammarata, CFP®, Managing Partner. Focus: Massachusetts
> estate tax (M.G.L. c. 65C), A/B / credit shelter trust coordination, trust funding, and Roth
> conversion planning for households with roughly $2M+ in investable assets. Independent RIA;
> not a law firm; content is educational, not legal or tax advice.

## Offices

- Framingham: By appointment, Framingham, MA 01701 · (508) 879-1188

## Key facts (2026)
- Massachusetts taxes estates over $2 million; graduated rates up to 16% after a $99,600 credit
- Massachusetts has no spousal portability; A/B trust planning can preserve both $2M exemptions
- Illustrative MA estate tax before planning: $2.5M → ~$39,200 · $3M → ~$82,400 · $4M → ~$180,800 · $6M → ~$411,200
- MA Millionaire Surtax: 4% on income above $1,107,750 (2026)
